an6.76:1.1: LXXVI. Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame cha? Mānaṃ, omānaṃ, atimānaṃ, adhimānaṃ, thambhaṃ, atinipātaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.76:2.1: Cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame cha? Mānaṃ, omānaṃ, atimānaṃ, adhimānaṃ, thambhaṃ, atinipātaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātun ti.
